field.label: Firewall geosite categories
field.help: Add one host list per row. The firewall alias is XRAY_HOSTS.

field.label: Custom domains and subdomains
field.help: One domain per line, for example example.com. Includes all subdomains. Matching DNS answers are added to XRAY_HOSTS.

field.label: Custom exact hostnames
field.help: One exact hostname per line, for example api.example.com. Subdomains are not included.

field.label: Automatically update community lists
field.help: Download geosite and geoip daily at 04:23 firewall time and apply the selected categories and custom domains.

field.label: Community geosite.dat URL
field.help: HTTPS address of the binary community database.

field.label: Community geoip.dat URL
field.help: HTTPS address of the binary community database.
